---
name: Data takedown / revocation request
about: Request removal or correction of published probe data associated with you
title: "Takedown request: "
labels: takedown
---

Describe the specific published record(s) you are requesting be revoked
(approximate date/hour, source IP, username, or path). Include enough detail
to locate the entry in the accepted rollups (`data/rollups/*.json`) or the
acceptance ledger (`data/acceptance-ledger.json`).

Every entry is labeled with the reporting source ID and source epoch that
submitted it.
